issuer.description: Card issuer or bank name, e.g. Barclaycard, American Express

card_last4.description: Last 4 digits of the card number only, never the full number

period_start.description: Statement period start date, ISO yyyy-mm-dd

period_end.description: Statement period end / statement date, ISO yyyy-mm-dd

opening_balance.description: Previous/opening balance in pounds. Positive when money is owed; negative if the account was in credit

closing_balance.description: New/closing balance in pounds. Positive when money is owed; negative if in credit

printed_total_debits.description: Printed total of new spending, fees and interest for the period if the statement shows one

printed_total_credits.description: Printed total of payments and credits for the period if the statement shows one

date.description: Transaction or posting date exactly as printed, or ISO yyyy-mm-dd if unambiguous

description.description: Full description line as printed, including merchant and location

direction.description: debit = increases what is owed (purchases, fees, interest, cash); credit = reduces it (payments, refunds)

kind.description: Best guess at the transaction type

foreign_currency.description: True if the line shows a non-sterling amount or exchange rate
